reviews.allowed_action: Record reviewed deferral and reasons; retain current hold, lane, detected_at, attempts and pending status. Reassess only on demonstrable new material evidence.

compared_signal.current_history_content: General 4.7% budget increase; no figures for APS, Ricarte Soto, newborn support or contingency reallocations.

reviews.relationship: Shared budget process, but a materially different program-level allocation and policy-risk signal.
interpretation_constraints: Article frames contingency changes as internal redistribution toward APS, not wholly additional expenditure.
Budget proposal and parliamentary discussion are not enacted appropriations.

Ministry response quoted in article disputes any reduction of existing Ricarte Soto patient guarantees and says continuity is protected; do not infer withdrawn coverage from the proposed fund reduction.
Real and nominal percentage changes must remain labeled separately.
Dates for photographed prior events, including Aug14 image, are not publication dates.
reviews.allowed_action: After genuine article verification, preserve the queue fingerprint/lane/detected_at/attempts and append this reviewed resolution. Remove only the obsolete mechanical hold; existing >=72 materiality, incremental-value and publication gates still decide.

compared_signal.reference_period: July 2026 effective contributor stock; linked May contract-signing turning point
compared_signal.current_history_content: Generic reported contributor inflection, no figures or method; visible DF item is editorially degraded to58 in current feed.

reviews.relationship: Related competitive inflection story, but different measurement, reference month and publication date. DF explicitly connects July stock to earlier May signings; they are not independent corroboration of the same numeric count.
new_incremental_fields: Explicit May contract-flow counts and arithmetic, absent from the currently stored DF signal.
Clear leading-indicator/effective-stock distinction and the publication/reporting lag.
interpretation_constraints: 52 net signings are not 525 effective-stock additions, and neither number demonstrates an increase in May effective stock.
DF body says July stock, not May stock; May is the underlying earlier signing turning point.
Publication remains Jul14 historical backfill; discovery Oct11 must not make the event fresh.
Existing DF coverage must be provided as related context to analysis; if no standalone incremental decision value remains, reject or defer rather than publish a second inflection headline.
Do not upgrade media-reported measurements to official confirmation merely because publisher cites Superintendencia.
reviews.allowed_action: After article verification, resolve the exact-duplicate uncertainty and allow unchanged editorial analysis with both metric definitions and existing DF context. Preserve lane, captured dates, attempt count and terminal state; publication approval remains false.
